g.text: Every Δt(m): re-evaluate via Oracle → Fabric
Co-located sessions see reduced m' next poll
⑥ Revoke → ⑦ Update L_cum → ⑧ Submit Receipt
Non-zero → bug or tampering → forensic review
Fabric returns DT_score → Gateway computes m
Budget check + CSRP: m' = m − η_N·R_N
Algo 2 polls every Δt(m); revoke if m≤0
Submit CAAR receipt via Oracle → Fabric
Admin γ=0.05 | User γ=0.10 | Guest γ=0.15
